changelog: COMPLETE REDESIGN: Load & Bill Management module — professional POS-style interface
NEW: Dashboard Summary — today's total load, bills, wallet received/sent, profit, due, grand total
NEW: Load Management — receive load from company, sell with extra charges + due tracking, live company balances
NEW: Bill Payment — amount + service charge + due tracking, auto-separates bill amount from profit
NEW: Digital Wallet Management — multiple JazzCash/Easypaisa/Bank accounts, receive/send with charges, per-account ledger
NEW: SIM Management — add SIMs to stock (New/Replacement), sell SIMs, per-company stock summary
NEW: Unified Checkout — every transaction shows live total (amount + charges) before confirming
NEW: Reports tab — load/bill/wallet/SIM profit summary, total due, grand total profit
NEW: Due tracking on all transaction types (load, bill, wallet) — record partial payments
NEW: Database tables: WalletAccount (multiple accounts), SimStock (SIM inventory)
FIXED: Settings version display — reads package.json from filesystem at runtime
